skill.summary: Discover, profile, and deeply analyze LinkedIn users — explore professional profiles, contact information, work experience, education, skills, publications,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of keyapi-linkedin-user-analytics.

- Enables discovery, profiling, and deep analysis of LinkedIn users and professionals.
- Supports retrieval of comprehensive information: profiles, contact info, posts, experience, education, skills, certifications, publications, honors, recommendations, interests, and content activity.
- Provides clear usage documentation, prerequisites, and how to call each endpoint.
- Introduces a unified, cache-first workflow for efficient LinkedIn user analytics.
- Built to use the KeyAPI MCP service and requires a KEYAPI_TOKEN and Node.js v18+.
